name: Gryth Thurden
summary: In Ironforge, Gryth Thurden is preparing to send a parcel back to Loch Modan. Golnir Bouldertoe has entrusted you with the Honorary Picks for Brock Stoneseeker's mining apprentices, and the city's gryphon roost offers a way across the mountain roads.

sections.title: A Courier for the Miners
sections.body: After traveling from Loch Modan to the Great Forge, you receive Honorary Picks from Golnir Bouldertoe for Brock Stoneseeker's mining apprentices. Golnir points you toward Ironforge's gryphon network instead of the mountain passes on foot. Carry the bundle across the city to its master handler, who can arrange the flight back.

sections.title: Taking Wing to Thelsamar
sections.body: Gryth Thurden oversees the flight roosts in Ironforge's great mountain hall. The gryphon routes link the city with dwarven settlements across Khaz Modan. After you have scouted the route and spoken with the local handler, Gryth can arrange transport back to Thorgrum Borrelson in Thelsamar. The picks are bound for Brock Stoneseeker's apprentices, and the route joins the mountain settlements by air.

faq.q: What are the Honorary Picks for?
faq.answer: Golnir Bouldertoe crafted the Honorary Picks in Ironforge as ceremonial tools for the students of Brock Stoneseeker, a mining instructor stationed in Thelsamar.
Gryth Thurden is Ironforge's master gryphon handler. He oversees flight routes from the dwarven capital to settlements across Khaz Modan and beyond.

faq.q: Where is Gryth Thurden located in Ironforge?
faq.answer: Gryth Thurden is at the Great Forge's flight roost, near Ironforge's main central thoroughfare and gates.

faq.q: Why do I need to talk to Thorgrum Borrelson first?
faq.answer: Gryth Thurden can send a rider to Thelsamar only after you have spoken with Thorgrum Borrelson, the handler stationed in Loch Modan. The handlers dispatch riders along charted routes.

faq.q: What happens after giving the picks to Gryth Thurden?
faq.answer: After inspecting the parcel, Gryth prepares a gryphon flight so you can return to Thelsamar and deliver the tools directly to Brock Stoneseeker.

faq.q: Who sends you to Gryth Thurden?
faq.answer: Golnir Bouldertoe, an artisan working around Ironforge's Great Forge, gives you the picks and directs you to Gryth.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you rely on gryphons to cross treacherous peaks, a practical necessity and a point of ancestral pride that links the mountain halls.
As a miner, you help Brock Stoneseeker's apprentices in Loch Modan with ceremonial picks forged in Ironforge to honor their craft.
As an Alliance member, you can rely on Ironforge's gryphon roosts to carry envoys between Dun Morogh, Loch Modan, and the broader kingdoms.
